{{Top|leg}}
A '''hub''' was the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] center for [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. It was a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]-shaped regulating device set in the center of the breastplate. Hubs powered the [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxer's]] armor, in addition to providing readouts for scorekeepers and [[Medic/Legends|medics]].

If an opponent was hit in the hub with an ion-charged [[shockmitt]], the shield could be disabled. If disabled, it could cause an ion-out. Hits to the hub were known as hub-busters.
